qualification_rule: A smoke, dirty-tree, incomplete, or hardware-mismatched run cannot pass. V2 remains NO-GO until V2-G13 records a qualifying decision.

gates.title: Software and namespace contract
pass_criteria: Every V2 and shared test passes on a clean pinned revision
V1 remains importable and behaviorally isolated from V2
The environment manifest records Python, TensorFlow, NumPy, OS, and source revision
gates.rationale: Execution is necessary but not evidence that the NAS objectives or proxies are useful.

gates.title: One-million-draw canonical-space audit
pass_criteria: Encode/decode and canonicalization are idempotent for every draw
No two different canonical genomes share a phenotype hash
Channel, family, operator, repeat, depth, and duplicate distributions are reported without post-hoc exclusions
gates.rationale: Ten thousand draws are useful smoke coverage; one million is the qualifying bias and alias audit requested by Round 2.

gates.title: Ten-thousand-model compute profile
pass_criteria: Every cohort member has Params and traced graph FLOPs or an explicit retained failure
Latency uses warm-up, device synchronization, fixed batch/input shape, and raw timings
Profiles retain architecture hash, family stratum, width, repeat depth, hardware, and failure reason
gates.rationale: Analytical FLOP guesses are not accepted; the external runner is bound by RESULT_CONTRACTS.md.

gates.title: Five-hundred-model executable gate
pass_criteria: Exactly 500 distinct canonical architectures are attempted
All 500 produce the correct finite output and finite connected gradients
There are zero unexplained failures; every failure seed and full architecture remains in the report
gates.rationale: Boundary phenotypes are added explicitly; random family balancing alone can miss all-skip, maximum-repeat, and largest-width cases.

gates.title: Target-device peak-memory gate
pass_criteria: The deployment target, batch, precision, input size, and memory budget were preregistered
Peak inference and Adam-step memory are measured in fresh processes
Every OOM is retained and no qualifying case exceeds the preregistered budget
gates.rationale: There is no universal acceptable VRAM number; passing is relative to an explicitly declared target device and use case.

gates.title: Objective redundancy analysis
pass_criteria: Pearson and Spearman correlations include bootstrap confidence intervals
Correlations are reported overall and by family/width stratum
Absolute Spearman at or above 0.95 triggers a redundancy review rather than an automatic objective deletion
gates.rationale: A correlation warning is diagnostic; deleting Params or FLOPs automatically would confuse statistical redundancy with deployment relevance.

gates.title: Blinded proxy decision preregistration
pass_criteria: Proxy definitions, seeds, transforms, exclusions, target metrics, and family strata are frozen before trained outcomes are unblinded
Minimum useful correlation and stability thresholds are justified for this task rather than copied as universal constants
Aggregation is forbidden until every component proxy is calibrated individually
gates.rationale: The audit does not justify inventing a synthetic AZ score or a universal correlation cutoff.

gates.title: Individual-proxy calibration
pass_criteria: Each proxy reports finite rate, repeated-seed stability, runtime, and failures
Rank correlations with Params, FLOPs, width, depth, family, and trained target are reported with confidence intervals
The frozen proxy plan decides PASS or FAIL without post-hoc threshold changes
gates.rationale: A proxy that mostly ranks model size or one primitive family is not a valid quality proxy for this mixed space.

gates.title: One-hundred-model short-training rank gate
pass_criteria: All models use the same frozen data, degradation, augmentation, optimizer, schedule, and evaluation code
Three seeds per model are retained and uncertainty is propagated into rank analysis
The preregistered rank and family-bias criteria pass on validation PSNR/SSIM
gates.rationale: Zero-cost scores cannot authorize NAS until they rank actual SR training outcomes under a controlled recipe.

gates.title: Conditional aggregate-proxy gate
pass_criteria: Only individually passing proxies enter the aggregate
Weights are fitted and evaluated with nested or held-out validation
The aggregate beats the best single proxy under the frozen criterion without increasing family bias
gates.rationale: This gate is skipped, not failed, when no aggregate was preregistered or when individual proxies do not pass.

gates.title: Residual-head ablation
pass_criteria: The same architecture initialization seeds and training recipe are paired across head modes
Quality, convergence, Params, FLOPs, latency, and failure rate are reported
The scientific default is retained or changed from the paired evidence, not convenience
gates.rationale: The residual-over-bicubic head is plausible for SR but is still a confound relative to V1 and must be measured.

gates.title: Multi-seed evolutionary and prior-sensitivity dry run
pass_criteria: Every run reports unique phenotype rate, duplicate rejection, mutation distance, family drift, depth/cost drift, and objective correlations
Canonical-uniform, depth-stratified, cost-stratified, and preregistered skip-rate initialization use identical budgets and five common seeds without mixing cohorts
Conclusions are reported by prior and no unexplained crash, cache alias, or systematic family collapse remains
gates.rationale: Uniform canonical sampling removes representation multiplicity but heavily favors dense V2 branches. One seed or one initialization prior is not evidence that the search formulation is stable.

gates.title: External NSGA-III cross-validation
pass_criteria: Reference-direction association, normalization, niching, and selection match an independent trusted implementation on deterministic fixtures
Differences are either eliminated or documented with a sensitivity analysis
The code is not called canonical NSGA-III unless the cross-validation passes
gates.rationale: The repository intentionally names its optimizer ReferenceDirectionEA until independent equivalence is demonstrated.

gates.title: V2 release and full-NAS authorization
pass_criteria: Every mandatory gate has a verified qualifying PASS and every conditional gate is PASS or JUSTIFIED_SKIP in the signed ledger
Protocol deviations, exclusions, failed seeds, OOMs, and negative results remain visible
The signed decision states GO, REVISE, or NO-GO and identifies exactly which claims are authorized
gates.rationale: Until this gate passes, V2 is executable and experiment-ready—not empirically validated or SoTA.
